collection.description: One child accidentally breaks a sibling's treasured toy and panics.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (child) accidentally breaks (sibling)'s treasured toy and panics.

choices.label: Suggest Making Amends in Another Way

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: (sibling) appreciates the honesty but remains sad.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The toy is repaired, though a visible crack remains.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The repair fails, and the children grieve the loss together.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The silence lasts longer than expected, and (adult) gently checks in.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: A thoughtful handmade gift helps the siblings reconnect.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: (sibling) declines a replacement and asks for more care next time.
